findings.description: The match check changed from re.match (prefix match) to fullmatch (whole-string match), which the commit title does not announce.
findings.rationale: Trigger: retry_if_exception_message(match='foo') on an exception whose str is 'foo bar'. Before this change, match() returned a truthy result and the exception was retried. After it, fullmatch() returns None, so the exception is no longer retried. Impact: existing users who rely on prefix-style regex matching silently lose retries on those exceptions, with no error raised.
